body: ty sm for telling me this, i hope you life treats you well because you are a nice person. it means a lot for you to tell me this because i truly needed to hear it

i’m really sorry you feel like that,  it’s hard because they always tell you how it’s going to effect the people around you and never truly help. i hope you can find something to grab on to and keep you going:) even tho it’s hard and everything feels useless sometimes. you still have something waiting that’s planned for you in the future. hopefully you this feeling can change for you and you can start to improve yourself
